title: Delivery & Pickup Appointments Held by One Customer
content:
**Rule.** A customer may hold any number of Delivery & Pickup Appointments over time, one for each purchase order handover. No overall maximum applies to the number of appointments one customer may have.

The limits on how many appointments may be **open** are separate. One limit applies per purchase order and another per date and window, and both belong to the rule on open appointments per purchase order.

### The rule in parts

| Question | Answer under this rule |
|---|---|
| Is there a maximum number of appointments per customer? | No. There is no maximum. |
| What does one appointment correspond to? | The handover of one purchase order. |
| Where do limits on open appointments come from? | The open-appointment rule per purchase order and per window, not this rule. |

### Hypothetical illustration

A repeat buyer has bought three vehicles from Kestrel Auto across several years, each on its own purchase order. The buyer's account shows three appointments, one per order handover. This rule sets no ceiling that a fourth purchase would breach.
